Rules.InvariantScript: If(IsBlank(gallery_donations_1.Selected.ID), "Nothing to show.", gallery_donations_1.Selected.Approved, "Approved. It can't be changed any more.", "Waiting for approval. You can still change it or add files.")
"This removes the submission and its attachments, and it won't be sent for approval. It can only be brought back from the SharePoint recycle bin."

Search(Sort(Filter(Choices([@'Financial Submissions'].'Type of thing'), Value <> "Income" && ((gallery_donations_1.Selected.'Type of thing'.Value = "Deposit") || Value <> "Deposit")), SortOrder.Ascending), DataCardValue22Yours.SearchText, Value)
Sort(Filter(Choices([@'Financial Submissions'].'Type of thing'), Value <> "Income" && ((gallery_donations_1.Selected.'Type of thing'.Value = "Deposit") || Value <> "Deposit")), SortOrder.Ascending)
If((gallery_donations_1.Selected.'Type of thing'.Value = "Deposit"), Filter(Choices([@'Financial Submissions'].'Type of thing'), Value = "Deposit"), Parent.Default)
If(locProjectAdded, "Refresh project list", "+ Add a project")

If(locProjectAdded, Refresh('Chargeable Projects'); UpdateContext({locProjectAdded: false}), Launch("__MS_LISTS_SITE__/Lists/Chargeable%20Projects/NewForm.aspx"); UpdateContext({locProjectAdded: true}))

Search(Sort(Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts','Project Class'.Value=ProjectDropDownYours.Selected.'Project Class'.Value),'Cost Account Number',SortOrder.Ascending),CostAccountDropdownYours.SearchText,'Cost Account Number and Description')
Sort(Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts', 'Project Class'.Value = ProjectDropDownYours.Selected.'Project Class'.Value), 'Cost Account Number', SortOrder.Ascending)
Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts', ID = gallery_donations_1.Selected.'Cost Account'.Id)
"No files yet. Add a receipt, invoice or photo."
With({p: LookUp('Chargeable Projects', 'Project Name' = "Income")}, {Id: p.ID, Value: p.'Project Name'})
Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts', ID = gallery_donations_1.Selected.'Cost Account'.Id)
Sort(Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts', 'Project Class'.Value = "Income"), 'Cost Account Number', SortOrder.Ascending)

Search(Sort(Filter('Chargeable Cost Accounts','Project Class'.Value="Income"),'Cost Account Number',SortOrder.Ascending),CostAccountDropdownIncomeYours.SearchText,'Cost Account Number and Description')
"No files yet. Add a receipt, invoice or photo."

If(Coalesce(locYoursTab, "Open") = "Approved", SortByColumns(Filter('Financial Submissions', 'Created By'.Email = CurrentUser.Email && Approved = true), "Created", SortOrder.Descending), Filter(Filter('Financial Submissions', 'Created By'.Email = CurrentUser.Email && Processed = false), Approved <> true))
ThisItem.'Type of thing'.Value & " · " & If(ThisItem.Processed, "Processed", ThisItem.Approved, "Approved", "Waiting for approval")
If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Cost Account'.Value), "No project or cost account", If(IsBlank(ThisItem.'Cost Account'.Value), "", ThisItem.Project.Value & " - " & ThisItem.'Cost Account'.Value))

If(!IsBlank(gallery_donations_1.Selected.ID) && !gallery_donations_1.Selected.Approved && locDelId = gallery_donations_1.Selected.ID, IfError(Remove('Financial Submissions', LookUp('Financial Submissions', ID = gallery_donations_1.Selected.ID)), Notify("Could not delete: " & FirstError.Message, NotificationType.Error), Notify("Submission deleted", NotificationType.Success)); UpdateContext({locDelId: Blank()}); Refresh('Financial Submissions'))
If(Coalesce(locYoursTab, "Open") = "Approved", "Nothing approved yet.", "Nothing waiting for approval.")
